msContents.summary: A paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.finalRubric:
iti śrī itihāsasamuccaye vyāsabhāṣite
saṃsārakūpekathanaṃ saptatriṃsat_mo dhyāyaḥ ||
msItem.colophon:
saṃvat 1822 vaitravadi 12 malamāsasamaye samāpta
pustaka premarājamiśra kī paropakāra iyaḍhanārthaṃ śrīrāmajīsahā śrīkeśavadevajī sahāya

lg.l: kathayiṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvān adbhutāṃs tava ||

lomaśaṃ dharmatatva
jñaṃ jñānaṃ pṛchad yudhiṣṭiraḥ || 1
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahmaṃ bhayārtta śaraṇāgataṃ ||

tasya
puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 2

ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣi
ṇā ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3
evam eva purā devāḥ tulayā samatolayan ||

prāṇara
kṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 4
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||

iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śi
ver auśīnarasya ca || 5
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śivaṃ nṛpaṃ ||

iṃdra śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā ta
traiva jagmatuḥ || 6
atha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||

śaraṇārthaṃ mahīpālaṃ nili
lye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7
tataḥ śanain upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ ||

rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ
vacas tadā || 8
dharmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitāṃ ||

sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ
hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi || 9
bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenā'nṛtavādinaṃ ||

kṣamayā krūrakarmā
ṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā'jayat || 10
no'pakārāparo 'py evam upakāraparo janaḥ ||

apakāraparo pi tvam upa
kāraparo yathā || 11
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe tvam apāpakṛt ||

doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatat_pa
raḥ || 12
tad evaṃ vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||
mā hiṃsiīr lobhato dharmmaṃ dharmas utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13
saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāsam anuprāptaḥ prāṇā gṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ || 14
tad evam āgatasyā'sya kapotasya bhayātmanaḥ ||
katham asmadvidyāḥ kuryus tyāgaṃ sadbhi vigarhitaṃ || 15

lobhād dveṣād bhayā
d vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃ ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16

sāstreṣu niḥkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpā
takinām api ||
śaraṇāgatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit || 17

yathātmani priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ
tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayatras trās trānadātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ || 18
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||

jaṃ
tavaḥ parikliśaṃti mṛtyos trasyaṃti taṃ tathā || 19
yaṃnimittaṃ bhavechokas trāso vā krodha eva vā ||

āyāso vā yato
mūlam ekāṃgam api saṃjyajet || 20
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

yuktes tenānumānena paro pi
parirakṣitum || 21
yathā hi taṃ jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ ||

saṃrakṣatāṃ jīvitam ā
tmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣi jīvitaṃ || 22
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam 'arppayiṣye kapotakaṃ ||

yad atra yuktaṃ
manyaṃte karttu syenāśu tad vada || 23
āhārāt_ sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti janeśvara ||

āhāreṇa
vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 24
śakyate na vināpy arthe rājan_ varddhayituṃ ciraṃ ||

śakyate duḥkare py arthe ci
rārātreṇa jīvitum || 25
nārthair anyai vināhāraṃ jīvitaṃ kasyacid bhavet ||

na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayi
tuṃ ciraṃ || 26
bhakṣād viyojitasyāsmān_ mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||

vihāya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhu
vaṃ || 27
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāra mariṣyati ||
rakṣamānaḥ kapotatvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān_ haniṣyasi || 28

dharma yo vā
dhate dharmaḥ na sa dharmo na mataḥ satāṃ ||
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate || 29

tasmād virodhe dharmasya viciṃ
tya gurulāghavaṃ ||
yatoaḥ śreyas tato rājan_ kuru dharmavinirṇayaṃ || 30

bahukalyānasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase
vihagottama ||
suparṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ tvaṃ hi dharma eva na śaṃśayaḥ || 31
yathā hi dharmayuktaṃ ca bahudharmacitraṃ prabhāṣase ||
na teṣv a'viditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ || 32
tasmāt_ bhūyastaro dharmaḥ kaścit_ anyo sti khecara ||

prāṇi
nāṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 33
varam ekasya satvasya datvā tv a'bhayadakṣiṇā ||

na tu viprasahasrasya go
sahasram alaṃkṛtaṃ || 34 ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||

tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate ka
cit || 35
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayaopradaḥ || 36

mahatā
m api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 37

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ
tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā ||
sarvāṇy a'bhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśī || 38

catusāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthai
vīm imām ||
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ || 39
api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vāpi dustyajaṃ ||

na
tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ || 40
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani ||

bhaveyam aham ā
rttānāṃ praṇinām arttināśanaḥ || 41
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājye na svarga nāpunarbhavaṃ ||

prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ kā
maye bhayanāśanaṃ || 42
yathā ca nānṛtā vānī mamaiṣā samudāhṛtā ||

satyena tena bhagavān_ prasīdatu ma
heśvaraḥ || 43
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgamaḥ ||
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy ahaṃ || 44
eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ ||
tamovotsṛjya nāhārai karyam asty aparair mama || 45

śyenāḥ
kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājan_ sāratāṃ jñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha || 46
nāhaṃ tv aśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama ||
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ || 47

sarvasatve
ṣu yat_ dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā ||
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikā smin_ viśiṣyate || 48

sarve vedā na tat ku
ryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecarāaḥ ||
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 49

vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu
sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
dayādarśitapāṃthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 50

gachatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapa
to pi vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ || 51
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||
ātmavatparirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 52
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||

sa yāti nara
kaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 53
rājyaṃ śivīnāṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvija ||

yad vā kāmayase hy anya
d varjayitvā kapotakaṃ || 54
yadi rājan_ kapotena sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||

tataḥ kapotatulyā
ni svamāṃsāni prayacha me || 55
anugraham idaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase ||

etaṃt te haṃ prayachā
mi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi || 56
yad apriyaṃ tat sujana cirād vadati vā na vā ||

mama tu priyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ
cirāt || 57
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārpayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ || 58
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate ||
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā || 59
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ nareśvara ||
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayaccha tulayā dhṛtaṃ || 60

tad e
vāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase ||
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tadvat tava vihaṃgamaḥ || 61
evam uktā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭaḥs tolayāmāsa sa kapotena saha prabhuḥ || 62

tyaktātmasukha
bhogecchāḥ sarvasatvasukhaikṣiṇaḥ ||
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ || 63

dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā ka
poto py atiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 64

na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samṃ kvaci
t ||
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃsā vāruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ || 65
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

nāpekṣaṃte te mahā
tmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api || 66
atha tasmin_ samārūḍho tulām ausīnareśvare ||

devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ pu
ṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca || 67
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmarājño dhṛtiṃ parāṃ ||
śākraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata || 68
idro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāṭ_ ayaṃ ||
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājan_ imaṃ jajñam upāgatau || 69

naitat sa
rvaṃ nṛpā cakru na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duḥkaraṃ nṛpa || 70

parārtha tyajataḥ prāṇān_
yā prītir abhavat tava ||
prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāyeṣu dehināṃ 71

parārthaikāṃtakalyāna svaśreyo tyaṃtaniṣṭhu
raḥ ||
tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan_ karuṇā vyatiricyate ||
svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat || 72

tvaṃ jaga
t_dukhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||
tathā sarvātmanā cāpi deho yaṃ prahataṃ tvayā || 73

yathaiva cātmanaḥ sthā
ne vāsanāpi na vidyate ||
akṛtverṣyaṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān apy avamanya ca || 74

akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhā tvaṃ loko
ttamatāṃ gataḥ ||
paropakārajanmāno vidhinā vihitās trayaḥ || 75

jaladā sajalās tvaṃ hi saphalāś ca mahādru
māḥ ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇā yo naraḥ parirakṣati || 76
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvarttate punaḥ ||

prāṇair api
tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ khagaḥ || 77
svamāṃsāni ca dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||

paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti ke
valātmodaraṃbharā || 78
sa punaḥ jīvikti ślāghyo yaḥ parārthe hi jīvati ||

kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatpa
rāḥ || 79
na hi svadehaśaitāya sa jñāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā || 80

sa padaṃ
tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ ||
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ || 81

jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhava
s tv adṛśā bhuvi ||
yat te māṃsāni mātrebhyaḥ samutkṛṃtāni pārthiva || 82
eṣā te sāsvatiī kīrtir lokān anugāmiṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā cirān mahīṃ || 83
sarvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati ||
evam uktā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ || 84
rājāpi ca kratum iṣṭāca mumude devavac ciraṃ ||

ya idaṃ śṛṇuyā
n nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ || 85
sa vihāyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ ||

viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ
yaśa sarvajanasya durllabhaṃ || 86
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || 87

body.p:
itihāsasamu
ccaye śenakapotīyo nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4
